components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled terracotta CTA; deepens to Terracotta Deep on hover rather than emptying, so it never loses prominence at the moment of intent.
components.html: Book a free intro chat
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; background: #bf4d28; color: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #bf4d28; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a8421f; border-color: #a8421f; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #bf4d28; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent teal-bordered CTA; inverts to solid teal on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; background: transparent; color: #20443f; border: 1.5px solid #20443f; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #20443f; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #bf4d28; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-tabs { border: 1px solid #e5dcc7; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; padding: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-tablist { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; background: #f4eee1; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5dcc7; } .ds-tab { cursor: pointer; padding: 16px 22px; font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #6f695f; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; transition: color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #20443f; } .ds-tab--on { color: #bf4d28; border-bottom-color: #bf4d28; } .ds-panel { padding: 32px; } .ds-mark { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Petrona', serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.4rem; color: #bf4d28; margin-bottom: 18px; } .ds-panel-body { font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #6f695f; }

narrative.overview:
The system is named plainly after the brand itself: no borrowed metaphor, no aesthetic pretense — the design should read as direct and personal as the name. The mood is warm, precise, and unhurried. Nothing on the page rushes the visitor toward a decision; typography, color, and pacing all signal that the person behind this site is calm, capable, and has nothing to prove through visual noise. Credentials speak for themselves; the design doesn't need to shout alongside them.

The palette is warm-editorial (cream paper tones, terracotta, deep teal, gold) rather than cool-corporate. Layout is generous and airy — full-width sections with consistent breathing room — never dense or app-like. The one confirmed anti-reference: this must not read as a generic SaaS/startup template. Every recurring pattern (card grids, eyebrow labels, pricing tiers) needs enough specific, warm detail that it couldn't be mistaken for an unrelated product's site with the copy swapped out.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream paper backgrounds, never stark white or cool grey
One confident accent (terracotta) used sparingly for action and emphasis; deep teal carries structural/heading weight
Generous whitespace and large section padding; nothing feels cramped or transactional
Soft, gentle elevation (light paper-lift shadows), never heavy or glossy
Warm, approachable interactive states — soft hovers, no jarring transitions

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Warm Terracotta is the only color that ever fills a primary call-to-action outside the dark contact band. If a new component needs a second "loud" color, it's a sign the composition needs rethinking, not a new token.

rules.name: The Italic Accent Rule
rules.body: Petrona's italic is reserved for small, personal touches only — the logo mark and the "How it works" step numerals — never for body copy or headings at large sizes, where it would read as overwrought.

rules.name: The Lift-on-Purpose Rule
rules.body: Shadow only appears on surfaces the visitor is meant to read as a discrete, liftable object (a card), never on structural chrome like the header or footer.

dos: Do keep Warm Terracotta rare — one primary action's worth of visual weight per screen, per the One Accent Rule.
Do use Chalkboard Teal for anything structural (headings, nav, outline buttons) rather than introducing a second neutral-dark color.
Do keep every surface warm-toned; no pure white, pure black, or cool grey anywhere in the system.
Do give every card the same 10px/Paper-Lift treatment so the system reads as one family, not a set of one-off components.
donts: Don't add a second competing accent color; if a new section needs emphasis, reuse terracotta or gold rather than introducing a new hue.
Don't let the display serif (Petrona) appear at body-text sizes or in long-form copy — it's a heading/accent voice only.

Don't reach for a generic SaaS/startup layout pattern (icon-in-a-tinted-square feature grid, gradient-circle avatar, unlabeled stat row) without adding a detail specific to this brand — that's the exact failure mode the critique flagged and this system exists to avoid.
